newsitem.title: ITALY: Five held in Milan for 1995 Gucci killing - agency.
newsitem.headline: Five held in Milan for 1995 Gucci killing - agency.

text.p: Five people were arrested in Milan on Friday in connection with the fatal shooting in 1995 of fashion king Maurizio Gucci, the Italian news agency Ansa reported.

Gucci, the former head of the fashion dynasty that bears the family name, was shot dead outside his office in Milan in March, 1995, by a well-dressed assassin. It was one of Italy's most mysterious recent killings.
Ansa said the five were two women and three men.
Gucci sold his 50 percent stake in the luxury leather goods and fashion empire two years before, ending the feuding family's involvement in a business that became a byword for elegance and status.
He had recently set up his own tourism business.
Gucci shares are traded in Amsterdam and New York.
